seo.title: Tune Easy — Simple Guitar Tuner for iPhone
seo.description: A guitar tuner that shows which way to turn the peg. Eleven tunings from standard to DADGAD, a chromatic mode and reference notes for every string. No accounts, nothing recorded.

hero.label: GUITAR TUNER
hero.title: Tune your guitar in seconds.
text: Play a string and Tune Easy shows which way to turn the peg. When it's right, the ring lights up. Eleven tunings, a chromatic mode and a reference note for every string. No sign-up, no subscriptions, nothing recorded.

items.title: Tune Up, Tune Down, In Tune
items.text: The dial shows how many cents flat or sharp a string is, and the headline says which way to turn. When the string is right, the ring lights up and you feel a tap.

items.title: Eleven Tunings
items.text: Standard, half and full step down, Drop D, C and B, Open G, D, E and C, and DADGAD. Tune Easy listens for the strings of the tuning you pick, down to Drop B's low B.

items.title: Strings in Tune
items.text: Every string you bring in tune is marked, and Tune Easy counts down to all six, with the next string to tune one glance away.

items.title: Reference Notes
items.text: Tap a string to hear its note, played as a plucked tone your iPhone speaker can carry, even for the low E.

items.title: Chromatic Mode
items.text: Tune a bass, a ukulele, a violin or your voice. The chromatic tuner names any note and plays a reference A.

items.title: Reference Pitch
items.text: Tune to A4 = 440 Hz, or anywhere from 425 to 455 Hz to match a piano or a recording.

items.title: Your Accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents for the in-tune ring. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions.

items.title: Day or Night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Nothing is recorded.
text: The microphone is used only while Tune Easy is on screen. Audio is analyzed on your iPhone and discarded: never recorded, stored or sent. No analytics, no ads, no tracking, no network requests.

cta.title: Get in tune.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
